title: The Jacobians of symbolic user functions by the automatic differentiation of exudyn.symbolic
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG12.54 (maintainer 2026-10-26): instead of central differences, the Jacobian of a symbolic user function (position, rotation, constraint, residual) could be derived by esym.Diff - per coordinate q[i] and q_t[i] it works now, but slowly; to be analyzed: a derivative as one more flat program, and whether n derivatives of a function of n arguments need a local stack of their own.
